acceptance_results.evidence: git status in the seeded run directory shows no change after the run.

All three named risks handled concretely: revocation with epoch-based session checks and per-decision evaluation_mode (enforced/shadow/fallback) captured in audit; drift bounded by revision-pinned shadow comparison with cause classification; audit continuity via a durable outbox, decision_id dedupe, and per-producer sequences with cutover markers.

Rollback is designed as switching the enforcement path back to a legacy evaluator that reads the new policy data (reverse-replicated during the rollback window) rather than re-authorizing the stale monolith database — keeping decisions consistent under rollback; automatic fallback stays banned.
